note.en: Pass the Cattolica Admission Test (online, 60 minutes, 48 questions, in English) or provide SAT/ACT scores. Thresholds: SAT 560 per section, ACT 23.

evidence.quote: Passing this test is equivalent to passing the Foundation Knowledge Assessment test (VPI).
